note: S/4HANA 2025, fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt#351 live measurement: a fresh function group in a transportable package whose main program (source/main) was changed, so the group and SAPL<group> (FUGR/I) were inactive. The group's reference alone was posted: preauditRequested=true (01) answered ioc:inactiveObjects and activated nothing — the inactive list at once (02) and about 10 s later (03) still lists both; preauditRequested=false on the same single reference (04) answered chkl:messages activationExecuted="false" with no message and also activated nothing (05, 06). Transport numbers are placeholders.

request.headersNote: Caller-supplied headers only. Recorded by a hand-run probe over HTTP; it added Authorization, sap-client, the stateful-session header, the session cookie and the CSRF token, none of which is recorded. Of the response headers only content-type was kept.
